name: 05_config_environment_beats_file
why: A variable already present in the process environment must never be overwritten by the file. That is what keeps `ANHUR_URL=... <plugin> recall` working for CI and one-off overrides. It is also the precedence that MASKED the 12,8-day blackout (187 interleaved successes whenever the key happened to be exported), which is why both plugins must report the SOURCE of the key, not just the key.

not_compared.vars_loaded: Different, documented meanings: Go reports how many variables it INJECTED into the process environment (core/envfile.go returns injectedCount, so a variable already set is not counted), Python reports how many it PARSED out of the file (config.py: env_file_variable_count = len(file_values)). Both numbers are diagnostics only - no branch reads them - and both loaders resolve the same values above. Worth aligning the wording one day; not worth failing a memory-integrity check today.

on_failure: If api_key_source is `file`, that plugin is ignoring an explicitly exported key - every override (CI, `ANHUR_URL=... hermes chat`, a rotated key exported for one run) silently writes to the wrong place.
